concerns.text: Edge case states 'The system must implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff... before failing the job', but no FR covers retry/backoff behavior. FR-001 only covers extraction and truncation. Add an FR (e.g. FR-007) anchoring this to US-1, or fold it into FR-001.

Edge case requires 'coverage score must be calculated as 0.0, and the record must be flagged for manual review if the threshold is not met', but no FR specifies the flagging-for-manual-review behavior or the threshold. FR-003 defines only the score ratio. Add an FR covering empty/whitespace docstring handling and the review flag.

US-3 scenario 3 requires a low-sample warning ('log a warning that statistical power may be low but still proceed') for datasets < 30 pairs, but no FR captures this behavior; FR-005 specifies only the Wilcoxon test and p-value reporting. Re-anchor by extending FR-005 or adding an FR referencing US-3.
